title: Planks and Iron Ingots
summary: Two loads wait in Blackwater: planks for Hanne Buckley and iron ingots for Hedda Coldwell. Mora Bulwark wants them moved before the next muster.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Hanne Buckley waits on planks and Hedda Coldwell on iron ingots. Fetch them in any order, before the next muster."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 4 planks from the ferry landing
Take 3 iron ingots from the second stack
Hand the planks to Hanne Buckley
Hand the iron ingots to Hedda Coldwell
Tell Mora Bulwark both are in
